description:
Location: Remote (Europe, Ukraine, other locations may be considered).

Contract: B2B, full-time.

Working hours: Flexible schedule, overlap 11:00–18:00 Kyiv time.

Languages: Ukrainian is mandatory (the team's working language). Fluent working English.

Compensation: Discussed individually.

About the role

Our client, a technology company building its own iGaming platform, is looking for a Head of Data & Analytics.

You will be the first person in this role, defining how game data is collected, measured and analyzed, and building the analytics function from scratch. The role is initially hands-on, with the opportunity to build and lead your own analytics team as the product grows.

You will report directly to the CEO and play a key role in shaping the company's gaming product strategy through data-driven decisions.

About the client

Established in 2018, our client is a technology company with a team of 40 professionals, transitioning from outsourced development to building its own products.

The company is developing its gaming direction for a strategic partner, a Singapore-based company with a portfolio of online casinos in the Asian market. The product operates in the real-money gaming industry.

  • The first instant games are ready, and a back-office with a CRM already collects player data down to session and round level.

  • A/B/C/D tests are supported, and there is a kill switch and an audit trail.

  • The next step is an open gaming platform where third-party game developers can launch their games and receive a share of GGR. The platform is currently at the planning stage, giving you the opportunity to shape its data architecture and analytics foundation from an early stage.

What you will do

You will own the completeness, quality and reliability of game data and turn analytical insights into actionable recommendations for the product team and the CEO.

  • Audit current event tracking and data, and define a tracking plan for the games and the back-office.

  • Build a unified player-level data model, an analytics layer and a metrics dictionary, including GGR, NGR, Theo GGR, RTP, retention, LTV and churn.

  • Establish experimentation methodology, including sample size, MDE, stopping rules and the statistical reliability of results.

  • Analyze game performance, player behavior and audience differences across countries, regions and traffic segments.

  • Provide data-driven recommendations on which games to scale, improve or discontinue, their placement in the game catalog, and revenue-sharing calculations for third-party game developers.

  • Deliver dashboards, regular reporting and anomaly alerts.

  • Establish data quality standards and financial reconciliation processes.

  • Design the data architecture, analytics roadmap and function budget.

  • Build the analytics team: define its structure, role profiles, hiring priorities and onboarding processes.

  • Work hands-on with SQL and data transformations at the start, gradually delegating responsibilities as the team grows.

What we are looking for

We are looking for a product-oriented analytics leader who has personally built analytics from scratch and is ready to take full ownership of the function.

We also consider strong Analytics Leads with people management experience who are ready to step into a Head-level role.

Must have

  • Personal experience building analytics from scratch, including tracking plans, data models, metric definitions and data quality rules.

  • Strong, current SQL skills and experience working with large volumes of event-level data.

  • Understanding of ETL/ELT processes, data architecture and analytics layer design.

  • Strong knowledge of experimentation statistics, including sample size, MDE, peeking, stopping rules and correct comparison of experimental groups.

  • Experience working with player-level or comparable user-level data and segmentation, including high-value users.

  • Understanding of key gaming metrics, including GGR, NGR, Theo GGR, RTP, retention, LTV and churn.

  • Understanding of win randomness, revenue concentration among high-value players, and the impact of traffic mix on game performance and experiment results.

  • Experience establishing data quality processes and reconciling analytical data with financial records.

  • People management experience, including hiring, onboarding, prioritization and team development.

  • Ability to design an analytics roadmap, evaluate architectural trade-offs and align technical decisions with business objectives.

  • Strong product mindset, ownership and the ability to translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations.

  • Readiness to work hands-on with data at the initial stage.

  • Ability to communicate complex analytical conclusions clearly to product stakeholders and the CEO.

  • Ukrainian at working level is mandatory, as Ukrainian is the team's working language.

  • Fluent working English.

Preferred industry experience

Direct experience in gaming analytics within the iGaming industry is our primary preference.

We are particularly interested in candidates with:

  • Experience working with iGaming game providers, game studios, casino operators or gaming platforms.

  • Direct experience analyzing game performance, player behavior, game mechanics and game economics.

  • Experience with instant games, crash games or other real-money gaming products.

  • Experience using analytics to guide game development, experimentation and product optimization.

Nice to have

  • Experience with BI tools and dashboard development.

  • Python or R.

  • Event streaming, data observability and data quality tooling.

  • Experience with analytics engineering and automated data transformation processes.

  • Fraud and bonus abuse analytics.

  • Understanding of game mathematics beyond standard RTP metrics.

What we offer

  • The opportunity to build and lead the entire gaming analytics function from scratch.

  • Ownership of the data architecture, analytics methodology, roadmap and future team.

  • Direct reporting to the CEO and meaningful influence on product and business decisions.

  • Real-money gaming products targeting the Asian market.

  • An existing back-office with round-level event data and experimentation infrastructure as a starting point.

  • The opportunity to shape the analytics foundation of a future open gaming platform.

  • The opportunity to build and develop your own analytics team as the product grows.

  • Long-term collaboration within a Ukrainian-speaking team.

  • Fully remote work with a flexible schedule.

Hiring process

  1. Interview with an OnHires recruiter.

  2. Technical interview with an independent analytics expert and the client's team.

  3. Reference and background checks.

  4. Final interview with the CEO and CTO.
